hook: "Our 1.8k-follower UGC creator pulled 12.2M views while some 400k-follower ones can't even hit 10k…"
body: The tier list: D ('check out this new app' — 0 tension), C (straight showcase — converts, never spreads), B (industry callout — reliable, capped), B+ (comparison — borrows competitor audience; Bevel vs Whoop: 49K likes on 89 followers), A (curiosity payoff — product IS the payoff; 7s video, 6,969 likes on 1K followers), A+ (founder confession — 210K likes, 105K saves), S (secondhand embarrassment — 5.1M views, 28K shares), S+ (disbelief: '4 years at the gym and NOW I find this?!!!??' — 12.2M views on 1.8K followers; reruns did 4.2M/2.4M/890K). The separator: S/A create an unresolved gap in frame one and make the product the closer; C/D announce the product first.
cta: "Test to run on your next batch: read ONLY the first line of text on screen — if it doesn't make you want the next 3 seconds…" (cut off in file).
idea: UGC hooks ranked D→S+: the disbelief hook ('4 years at the gym and NOW I find this') is S+ — 12.2M views on a 1.8K account — because it implies genuine discovery; S/A tiers open an unresolved gap and make the product the closer.
sequencing: Hook: 1.8K followers to 12.2M views vs 400K followers under 10K.
The thesis: hook quality is the 99% differentiator.
D + C tiers: 'check out this app' (0 tension); straight showcase (converts, never spreads).
B + B+ tiers: industry callout (capped); comparison — Bevel vs Whoop, 49K likes on 89 followers.
A + A+ tiers: curiosity payoff (product IS the payoff); founder confession (210K likes, 105K saves).
S + S+ tiers: secondhand embarrassment (5.1M views); the disbelief hook (12.2M views on 1.8K account).
The separator: S/A open an unresolved gap and make the product the closer; C/D announce the product first.
The self-test: read only the first line of on-screen text.
formatting: Tier-list thread: D→S+ with numbers per tier, the separator insight, a self-test. 259 bookmarks.
why_it_works: 'Implies she genuinely didn't know' — the disbelief hook works because discovery feels real, not sold. The gap-first vs product-first separator is the single most actionable hook principle in the library.
what_to_steal: The S+ disbelief hook as LC's headline formula ('4 years buying tarnishing jewelry and NOW I find this?!') + the separator rule: open an unresolved gap in frame one, make the LC piece the closer. The first-line self-test is LC's hook QA: read only the overlay text — does it earn 3 more seconds?
